opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by destination and keyword with sorting
opportunities.description: On Trip.com Attractions & Tickets, pick a destination city, optionally enter a keyword, search, sort results (Top Rated or Lowest Price) and open a result.
steps: Open Trip.com and click Attractions & Tickets
Click the destination field (City or Region) and enter or select the city
Type keyword in the Keywords field
Click the sort tab (Top Rated or Lowest Price)
